# usbuntu

> Install a complete, bootable, persistent Ubuntu desktop on a USB stick from an ISO, from the terminal. Not dd: it
> unpacks the ISO's squashfs layers, configures the system in a chroot and installs the signed boot chain, verified.

Install: `uv tool install git+https://github.com/jpsanders/usbuntu@1.2.0`. Use: `usbuntu devices` (safe targets, no
root), then `sudo usbuntu install ubuntu.iso --username NAME --device /dev/sdX`, then `sudo usbuntu verify /dev/sdX`.
